name: The National Gallery
tagline: Western European painting from the 13th to the 19th century, free to the public since 1824.

artworks.title: The Arnolfini Portrait
artworks.description: A merchant and his wife stand in a richly furnished room, a convex mirror on the back wall reflecting the whole scene — and, some say, the painter himself.

artworks.title: Sunflowers
artworks.description: Part of van Gogh's celebrated sunflower series, painted in Arles in a burst of yellow pigment to decorate the room he prepared for Gauguin's visit.
